name: 文泉驿微米黑
description: WenQuanYi Micro Hei is a free and open-source sans-serif typeface designed for screen display and user interfaces. It was developed as part of the WenQuanYi project, a Chinese open-source font initiative. The font combines the glyph structures of the Droid Sans and Hei Ti (黑体) styles, aiming to provide high readability at small sizes on digital screens. It supports a wide range of characters including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese Kana, and Latin alphabets. The design emphasizes clarity and legibility for electronic communication, making it suitable for UI design, web content, and mobile applications.
